grh_c69a1cd149bf0085b655.title: One For The Money
paragraphs: Eighty-five-year-old Harriet Petticord summons her three young heirs and recruits Dr. Christian and Judy for a test of character. Although still wealthy, Harriet has Christian tell them that bad investments have left her penniless and that her house and belongings must be sold. Her grandniece Carol, a struggling actress and playwright, is prepared to help, while Carol's twin brother Bill cannot come because he is in the Army and sends his friend Private Frank Kennedy with a letter. Cousin Roger, Harriet's outwardly devoted favorite, immediately suggests putting her in an institution and is exposed as having secretly married the woman Harriet once disapproved of while continuing to check on Harriet's fortune through her lawyer. Harriet reveals the bankruptcy was a ruse, reduces Roger to a five-dollar inheritance, welcomes Carol and Frank into her home, and agrees to become the financial 'angel' for Carol's play.

This [[show|dr-christian|Dr. Christian]] broadcast aired on March 6, 1946. It is listed as episode 380 in the archive. [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Jean Hersholt and Rosemary De Camp. Other credited names include Art Gilmore as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 24 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.b199d95f77b6c241|Vaseline]].

grh_c613c77d69bbd06770fa.title: Some Cat's Killed the Canary
paragraphs: Rocky fills in on bass at a jazz club and soon finds singer Evie Johnson murdered in a hotel room while Dolores, the drugged ex-wife of musician Johnny Lament, is being framed for the crime. The corpse disappears, but Rocky discovers Johnny hid it in a bass case and murdered Evie because she learned he was dealing narcotics. grh_c6db5f0acaee746066eb.title: My Uncle Toby
paragraphs: Gentle Uncle Toby, retired after a war wound, spends his life happily recreating military sieges with Corporal Trim until the determined Widow Wadman turns her attention to marrying him.
